chosen: The Lead Decay Curve: four time windows (0-5min, 5min-1hr, 1-24hr, 24hr+) and the distinct action required in each, teaching speed-to-lead as a decaying asset rather than a binary fast/slow metric
rejected: Three-call persistence framework (lower novelty, overlaps prior cadence content)
Lead temperature thermometer model (too similar in shape to the decay curve, less specific actions)
Follow-up debt framework (overlaps the already-shipped three-cost acquisition/delay/abandonment model)
Trust ladder revisited (already covered via dual-timer and prior ladder frameworks)
